en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor café or beer garden shaded by trees. Several people in traditional central‑European dress sit at tables or stand in the garden. Behind them is a light‑colored building with tall arched windows and simple classical ornament. To the left is a glass pavilion or conservatory structure. The overall scene feels relaxed and social, likely in the courtyard of a restaurant or inn.
